abstract: We report seven cases of metastatic mature teratoma in the lung from testicular teratocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma. The patients were between 19 and 58 years of age when orchiectomy was performed. The primary tumors each contained a prominent component of embryonal carcinoma as well as mature and immature teratoma in six patients and only embryonal carcinoma in one. In three patients metastatic pulmonary nodules were detected at the time of orchiectomy, and in three others pulmonary metastases occurred 4 and 8 months after orchiectomy. In one patient the interval was 1.5 years; however, chest roentgenography was not performed during that period. All the patients received chemotherapy or radiation therapy prior to removal of the pulmonary metastases. Thoracotomy was performed between 4 months and 9 years after detection of pulmonary metastases on chest roentgenograms. In one patient the procedure consisted of a lobectomy and in another a pneumonectomy. In the remaining five cases excision of the nodules was performed. The pulmonary metastases resected were grossly solitary lesions in five patients and multifocal in two. Microscopically, each tumor consisted entirely of mature teratoma. Cuboidal and mucin-secreting glandular epithelium predominated in the cystic areas; fibroconnective tissue was the predominant feature of the solid areas. In four patients the course has been indolent with no manifestations of the disease after at least 1 year; in two patients no follow-up was obtained; and one patient died, apparently of a septic process. We present a discussion of this interesting and unusual event.
abstract_ja: 精巣の奇形癌および胎児性癌に由来する肺転移性成熟奇形腫の7例を報告する。精巣摘除術を施行された時点での年齢は19歳から58歳であった。原発腫瘍は、6例では胎児性癌に加え成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫の成分が目立ち、1例では胎児性癌のみであった。3例では精巣摘除術時に肺転移結節が検出され、他の3例では精巣摘除術の4か月および8か月後に肺転移が生じた。1例では間隔は1.5年であったが、その期間中は胸部X線検査が施行されていなかった。全例が肺転移の切除前に化学療法または放射線療法を受けた。胸部X線写真で肺転移を検出してから4か月から9年後に開胸術が施行された。1例では肺葉切除術、別の1例では肺全摘術が施行された。残り5例では結節切除が施行された。切除された肺転移は、5例では肉眼的に単発病変、2例では多発病変であった。顕微鏡的には、各腫瘍は全体が成熟奇形腫からなっていた。嚢胞部では立方状で粘液分泌性の腺上皮が優勢で、充実部では線維結合組織が主な特徴であった。4例では1年以上にわたり病状は緩徐に経過し、疾患の徴候は認められなかった。2例ではフォローアップが得られず、1例は敗血症性の過程と思われる原因で死亡した。この興味深く稀な事象についての考察を示す。
